about_the_game:
Don't forget to wishlist and follow!

Explore without fear

Step into a serene, vibrant forest full of mysteries. There’s no hunting or violence here—exploration is about discovering unique resources, observing wildlife, and recording each find in your journal.

Build your refuge

Raise your cabin from scratch and customize it with furniture, decorations, and handmade items. Create a cozy home where every detail reflects your style.

Cook and cultivate

Gather plants, tend your garden, and combine ingredients to prepare over thirty recipes. Each dish is a new way to satisfy your hunger and enjoy the flavors of nature.

Live with animals

From chickens and sheep to bees and wild creatures, animals are part of your daily life. Raise them, watch them, and live peacefully alongside them, finding companionship and unexpected rewards.

A unique experience

Under Canopies redefines survival by leaving behind combat and danger. Here, you don’t fight against nature—you thrive with it.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 8.1, Windows 10 (64-bit versions only)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 or AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 670 or AMD R9 270
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 8.1, Windows 10 (64-bit versions only)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4770 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 or AMD R9 290X
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: Under Canopies is a relaxing, non-violent survival. No predators, no combat, just build your cozy cabin, raise animals, farm, cook, and explore a forest full of secrets. Live self-sufficiently in harmony with nature.
supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Russian, German, Spanish - Latin America, French, Italian, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal
